# Hair Transplant Answers

> Independent information and referral service for hair transplants and hair restoration in the US.
> We are not a medical clinic. We may be compensated when you connect with a provider.

## Key pages
- [What it costs](https://hairtransplantanswers.com/cost/): US pricing, per-graft costs, and a calculator.
- [Complete guide](https://hairtransplantanswers.com/guide/): how hair transplants work, methods, results.
- [FUE vs FUT](https://hairtransplantanswers.com/types-and-options/): the main techniques compared.
- [How it works](https://hairtransplantanswers.com/process/): the procedure step by step and recovery.
- [Choosing a clinic](https://hairtransplantanswers.com/choosing-a-company/): checklist and red flags.

## Notes
- Guidance is independent of any commercial relationship. See /disclosure/.
- Information only, not medical advice. Consult a qualified professional.
